answer: Operator Liability Escrow. Each wallet maps to a verified operator account that posts a refundable escrow covering all its wallets. When collusion detection flags a cluster, the penalty is deducted from the operator's escrow, not the wallets, and the operator must top it up before any wallet acts again. A tundra of cheap identities becomes worthless once one escrow backs the whole cluster. Nectar of repeated sybils is drained from a single pool. Each flagged cluster costs the operator a fixed escrow refill at the inlet, scaling with cluster size,
